g.text: NSA: three complementary reads of the causal past
[To be reviewed] Native Sparse Attention: learned summaries + selected detailed blocks + recent local context.
Causal hidden-state history → branch-specific K/V projections
Aggregate query heads within KV group
Read original token K/V in selected blocks
local patterns have a separate path
Gates = sigmoid(MLP(input)); they need not sum to 1. Every attention branch uses the current query q_t.
Dashed arrow: selection guidance. Compression and selection blocks need not have identical geometry.
Diagram is schematic: causal boundaries, overlapping blocks and group/kernel layout follow the trained architecture.
